default_currency.title: Currency when the website has none
default_currency.description: ISO-4217 code used only when the website's currency is not set in the Portal (Website settings). Empty: lines cannot be added until it is.

item_source.title: Item lookup
item_source.description: checkout: items your server posts (PUT /v1/items) or that the Catalog product's events mirror; catalog: also look items up live in the Catalog product's API when they are not mirrored yet.

catalog_url.title: Catalog product API base
catalog_url.description: https base URL of the Catalog product for this website (live lookups and catalog stock reservations). The server key comes from Dashboard → Integrations.

stale_lines.title: Lines that can no longer be bought
stale_lines.description: flag: keep them, marked unavailable (they block checkout until removed); remove: drop them and tell the shopper.

guest_merge.title: Merge a guest cart when the shopper signs in

abandoned_after_hours.title: Abandoned after (hours)
abandoned_after_hours.description: An open cart with lines untouched this long publishes checkout.cart_abandoned@1 once (for Automation / Messaging), when your server next reads it or from the dashboard's Process expired now. 0 = off.

allow_notes.title: Allow notes on the cart and its lines
